notes.title: Get Anima Flux At 20% OFF During The Couch Co-Op Fest
notes.content:
[i]Get ready to team up! Anima Flux, the thrilling co-op Metroidvania adventure, is taking part in the Steam Couch Co-Op Fest. This online celebration is dedicated to local co-op games, making it the perfect time to grab a friend, sit back, and dive into the dystopian world. The discount of 20% will be applied during the event.[/i]

[i][b]A Perfect Fit for Co-Op Fans[/b][/i]

Designed from the ground up with cooperative play in mind, Anima Flux offers a truly impressive co-op experience. Whether you choose to fight alongside a friend or take on the challenge solo with the second character controlled automatically, teamwork is at the core of the gameplay. The Steam Couch Co-Op Fest is a fantastic opportunity for players to explore the unique dynamics of the game and discover why it stands out among co-op adventures.

[i][b]Join the Action![/b][/i]

Throughout the event, players will be able to experience Anima Flux with an exclusive discount of 20%. This is a great chance to jump into the action, share the adventure with a friend, and explore the sci-fi aesthetics of Anima Flux.

Don’t miss out! Steam Couch Co-Op Fest runs from February 10-17, and Anima Flux is ready for you and your co-op partner to save humanity's last space city.

[i][b]About Anima Flux[/b][/i]

Anima Flux immerses players in a dystopian world where two genetically enhanced soldiers, special agents of a theocratic regime, must fight against a mutant invasion to save humanity’s last space city. Whether playing solo or co-op, players will engage in strategic combat, utilize unique abilities, and uncover a deep narrative that questions survival, ethics, and the fear of death.

[i][b]Key Features:[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] [b]Solo or Co-op Mode:[/b] Play alone, switching between two characters, while the other character will be handled by the game’s system, or team up with a friend for local co-op or online via Steam Remote Play.
[*] 
[*] [b]Unique Content:[/b] Explore, fight, and strategize your way through a series of challenging environments.
[*] 
[*] [b]Hand-Drawn Cutscenes:[/b] Experience the game’s story through beautifully animated sequences that enhance the game’s dark, dystopian atmosphere.
[*] 
[*] [b]Unique Visual Style:[/b] Drawing inspiration from retro sci-fi aesthetics of the '80s and '90s, Anima Flux presents a strikingly detailed and futuristic 2D world.
[/list]

Hurry up to get the game at 20% off:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/763180/Anima_Flux/

notes.title: 08/01/2024 - Demo Update
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that we are one step closer to release! We're currently in the polishing and balancing phase to ensure the best possible experience for our players. As part of this effort, we've updated the Anima Flux demo version with some exciting new features. Here are the details:

[b]Lore Entries:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a lore terminal and a new shop at NPC’s location.
[/list]
[b]Shop Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Improved the balance of upgrades available in the shop:[/b] We've enhanced the overall balance of upgrades in the shop, reducing the number of upgrade tiers.
[/list]
[b]Localization Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated existing languages, with some rewritten from scratch.
[*] Added new language - Simplified Chinese.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed minor and critical bugs, including boss freezes, getting stuck at the start due to alarm lamps, and content loss from quickly exiting the game at the very start. 
[*]Additionally, optimization work was done in problematic areas, making the demo significantly less demanding (or smoother).
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] We strongly recommend starting a new game before playing the demo.
If you'd like to help us test the game, please reach out to us on [url=https://discord.gg/xpxwzegj9f]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Anima Flux Big Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

It's been quite a while since we last updated our game's demo version, but the time has finally come! We're excited to present to you a detailed breakdown of all the new features in the update (well, almost all of them), now available to everyone on Steam!

We've been hard at work refining and adding exciting new content, and we can't wait for you to dive in and experience it for yourselves. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the game, we hope you'll enjoy what we've prepared for you.

So without further ado, fire up your Steam client and update your demo version now! And don't forget to let us know what you think – your feedback helps us continue to improve and polish the game to perfection.

[h3][b]Combat System Enhancements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Abilities:[/b] Characters now have new abilities from the beginning of the game to diversify combat.
[*] Swordsman now has the [b]Stagger Attack[/b] - a lunging strike that stuns enemies in front of you. Stunned enemies take double damage from your regular attacks.
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZGx3ejZsbDFmbmg0Z3k0NThqM2c1cms0eWd2aW13MGZsOGc2eTlxcCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/8E0trXqW5UZwUNC5fC/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] Archer's new [b]Rebound Attack[/b] - allows you to leap backward while firing an arrow, creating a short-lived decoy that absorbs enemy attacks.
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExems0MDE5NXR6eDYzczVwdWJtYjFscmJndHExZ294MGJyZ3JsOWI2diZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/7lmkGN3HQOHcMkNWzZ/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Empowered Special Attacks: [/b]Each character now has a gauge to enhance special attacks, which fills by meeting certain conditions.
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdnFzbzlnNGlhZXhlOHh0MWs0Y3d6MjVieDd6eW1oM213OWk4cnF2NCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/d1p9MIOCe4pPBS3P2x/giphy.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3][b]Improved Guide System:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] No more excuses for not learning the controls! A handy guide is now available in the pause menu, providing a clear overview of the basic gameplay mechanics.
[/list]

[h3][b]Enhanced Gameplay Experience:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Automatic Aiming:[/b] The archer now automatically locks onto the nearest enemy, while manual aiming remains available.
[*] [b]Button Buffer:[/b] Attacks, jumps, or dashes are automatically triggered after the previous action, enhancing fluidity in combat.
[*] [b]Gamepad Vibration:[/b] Feel the intensity of the battle with the new gamepad vibration options, which provide subtle feedback for minor damage and stronger pulses for heavy blows or character death.
[*] [b]Rage Mode Balancing:[/b] Unleash mayhem for extended periods with the rebalanced Rage Mode, which no longer stuns enemies but features a significantly longer duration and removes the previous penalty for early deactivation.
[/list]

[b]Note: [/b]This update includes various minor fixes and improvements to enhance overall gameplay experience.

💬 LEAVE YOUR FEEDBACK AND DISCUSS THE GAME: [url=https://discord.gg/xpxwzegj9f]Anima Flux Official Discord[/url]

notes.title: On the Highway to Release 11/03/2023 - Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We carefully evaluated and considered all the feedback we received during Steam Next Fest and today we’d like to share with you a list of improvements which we’ve implemented recently. 


[list]
[*] We’ve made the combat more balanced against groups of enemies, by adding a longer stun animation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/805d2dc7b6a3f501e0e6c35c34ca09838d9e9540.gif[/img]

[*] There is now a function to change controls in Game settings. You can now control characters using the D-Pad. 

[*] Improved game optimization, significantly increasing FPS.

[*] The player now has more control over the character while jumping. 

[*] The game's combat music has changed a bit. It appears more gradually. 

[*] The archer can now aim 320°, including full overhead aiming. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/5b96d3e0aeed63b7f24e71fcab7d5320de8de88c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/3d6eeb027a568bfa617f0d7ec99c38104f310cef.gif[/img]

[*] Cooperatives and hints have appeared in the game. Now in co-op mode, some actions can only be performed simultaneously with the second player. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/7d3bf4d75d9f563d73d4a5d36aaaceef933a5472.png[/img]


[*] There is full support for the PS5 controller.

[*] The number of enemies at levels has changed. 

[*] The amount of boss health has been balanced.

[*] Fixed the problem regarding the amount of enemy health changed the fact that it was different in co-op and single player. 
[/list]

Please update the demo and share your thoughts with us :) 
Stay tuned ;)

notes.title: On the Highway to Release 5/16/2023
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!

We've all been waiting for this moment. Fingers crossed. Hold our breath… and this is what happened! We’ve released a closed demo version of the Anima Flux game! And from this moment every member of our [url=https://discord.com/invite/TNET46mTPe]Discord community[/url] may play the game for an hour or so. And, of course, you are free to leave feedback for our devs. Also we have already implemented some of your suggestions into the game. [/b]

So, what’s new our devs have?

We are working on the navigation system update. AI copes with complex jumps between platforms much better. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/55d9a7399a89d0e72279f27ceaaed6e62e66905e.gif[/img]

Level design changes of some locations with more details. You can feel the dark atmosphere of the space city with your skin. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/de88111ddfc522b74d0b9251c7d55f0ed3f7c0d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/fc438f7147c2692270954a105ea846cda3c9852b.png[/img]

Added Commander El quest  with a fun dialog. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/ba3e0bf2181e8de31dee0935a9a1c08e2823c00c.png[/img]

There is a new group of engineers in Saferoom! From now on our characters won’t feel lonely while having a rest after a fight with mutants. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/e4e29b6a281f4a86c763e7da7cf87d60ac5590df.png[/img]

Also there is an animated biomass. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/15ba730278f077969743a3be07e128e21d585f4d.gif[/img]

We kindly remind you that anyone can test the Anima Flux demo. Just [url=https://discord.com/invite/TNET46mTPe]write in our Discord server[/url], and pretty soon the Steam-key will be waiting for you in the DM. 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 2021 Retrospective
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 2021 brought us lots of wonderful beginnings and even some achievements.

In this article, we'd like to cast your mind back to some great results, we achieved this year. 

First and most important: we participated in Dev.Play and NYX Game Awards! 

During [b]Dev.Play[/b] our game was live-streamed and more than 3000 players got a chance to see the gameplay first! 

At [b]NYX Game Awards 2021[/b] Lost in Sky won the golden awards in the categories PC Game - Indie Game and PC Game - Action Game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/1a99fdeeee03bd865ec717dff8c176049074e59e.jpg[/img]

We’re very proud that our game has been appreciated, and we’re keeping it up! 
With all the victories, contests, and streams we’ve had so much new energy that added a ton of new stuff. 

[b]New Character Look
[/b]
We announced Roy and Eileen’s new looks a while ago. Now it’s time to check them out in the game! 
How do you like them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/e6780b51d1ee128f42a33776ccc1ead1e685c8d2.gif[/img]

[b]Cut Scenes[/b]
If you’re following us on social media, you must have seen the new Lost in Sky trailer. If you aren’t, it’s time to subscribe! :D

The trailer shows fine examples of future cut scenes in the game, among other things. Here’s one for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/a99a100f0e649f649628fab20a0bac1fce9e6125.gif[/img]


[b]Coop Camera[/b]
We tweaked it to improve interaction and your comfort during cooperative play.
• The camera automatically zooms out when the distance between the characters increases. It zooms back in when the characters are closer;
• If the characters are too far from each other (you don’t want that on the Ark, by the by), a small windows pops up if your partner dies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/aadff4be88eb9cfcdee91866006d15bf7b2d790e.gif[/img]

[b]Weapons
[/b]
A very quick overview of new types of weapons.

Grenades. High AOE damage, different effects on different types of grenades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/f2c04249baf22dd485ed229de0a41b792bf4d82f.gif[/img]

Arrow tips. Long range, different effects on different types of arrow tips, of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/a569cd7baaaeac434ae15956844a2d9ee0fd6955.gif[/img]

[b]Map[/b]

As we are a classic case of a 2D action platformer, so the implementation of the most important metroidvania element was only a matter of time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/e2a9641d3772e4df4587533b400f862e1d939f79.gif[/img]

[b]The Rage Mode
[/b]
It’s not new, it has existed in the game for a long while. However weird it may sound, there was not enough rage in it. We tweaked it a bit, and the effect was astonishing: for a short period, the Rage kicks in, making the characters so strong that enemies simply blow up. Three marks on the Rage scale restore over time. The rest of it must earned in combat or found elsewhere. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/a927cf122e4947403ac1c5bfadb0af73d4fc32cb.gif[/img]

[b]Monster Buffing[/b]

By our GIFs,  you might think that combat in Lost in Sky is all too easy. Trust us, this is far from being true. And to assure every headshaker here, we've added another "obstacle," namely, the monster buffing. This means that some monsters will come in packs accompanied by a pack boss, which grants protection to his minions. There's no point in attacking other monsters before you defeat the pack boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/dc0e77b8dd10c99c427ef8580abe7a594171f120.gif[/img]

Thanks for following us! Stay tuned and Happy New Year! 🎄

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 09/11/2021
notes.content:
Hey!

Autumn is gaining momentum, it’s getting colder outside, and we’re rushing to warm your homes with our latest hot news. Sit closer, let’s get warm together.
In today’s program: latest coop features, UI update, concept art, and bloodbath!

[b]Coop Camera[/b]
We tweaked it to improve interaction and your comfort during cooperative play.
• The camera automatically zooms out when the distance between the characters increases. It zooms back in when the characters are closer;
• If the characters are too far from each other (you don’t want that on the Ark, by the by), a small windows pops up if your partner dies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/cbc569a7abffeb74ed46532e9b9718cee95164b6.gif[/img]

[b]Biomaterial Autocollector[/b]
We’re here to serve you! Tired of looting biomaterial? Purchase an “internal magnet” and watch the goodies literally fly in your direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/231b61202d43807005227c8b044bcbce4486e95a.gif[/img]

[b]Skill Screen[/b]
We’re filling in more UI information, such as the inventory or maps. Our latest addition is the tab with the description of all unlockable skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/1a7dfacb7f83ca62d28eeb6065b3765a307a7edc.gif[/img]

[b]Transformer[/b]
This is just some concept art. Looks cool but we wish we knew what to do with it! No worries, we’ll come up with something.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/8a557ed5ac00830aee7e5d9844ea84e1b992eb47.jpg[/img]

[b]New Cover[/b]
Overhauling our characters. You might have noticed how we replaced the covers and banners on Steam and social media.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/6dd1ab7f1398280c2fad8a3077d601bda3954967.jpg[/img]

We now take you to our What-If section!
"What if…"
• What’s gonna happen if you have a grenade on you and meet a spider? A spectacular kill and a spectacular walk-away. Cool guys don’t look at explosions 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/e1ef7f2af7994fe39270eb10e02ad57c615b324f.gif[/img]

• What if you take a stroll around ARK on your own? Your friends are going to miss a good fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/2c52e0e7961045456b110882c0ac2a4bb8dd1473.gif[/img]

• What if you go down the energy tunnel into the dark? You will encounter monsters. Seriously, did you expect something else?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/f486348e58b27654eacdf8ae386510ead4a511c4.gif[/img]

And now we give you the long-awaited screenshots! We’ll see you next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/4cd69cb4ee58f491b3837d44ac0782169b2bc3b0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/1cb0b9d9858fcd28e3f771c0ff6df1a57772c59b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/0fb49f8f2a377c0bf26d851da503d5f20e4c5c39.jpg[/img]

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 05/28/2021
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's almost summer, and everyone is packing to go on their holidays but we just can't stop! Let's go over the things we've done.

[b]Elevator Navigation[/b]
We've got a great number of elevators on Ark. It's getting hard to track down which goes where, so we decided to add some navigation for you. You'll find special signs on each elevator, showing their destinations. We hope it'll save you some hiking around Ark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/a80d3f12c8d318982d2dcd29ad08b12865fd5310.jpg[/img]

[b]Newborn Monsters[/b]
The Spring is a wonderful time! The nature is coming alive: plants, birds, animals, and monsters. Welcome two monster babies in our Bestiary. We can't reveal any details yet, but you'll have a chance to check out their abilities.
For instance, this baby is often compared to a unicorn, but not for its love to marshmallows!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/59e07a14f2ce44e4340eab8db98ce662ef47e560.gif[/img]

The other newcomer is way more serious. Its hard shell and humongous size allow it to take the most direct approach. It literally bulldozes you in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/cb464979db43539d3b003a7894f964a1b82db380.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/24cedb2d45c9ff3d455c370c39921ff20feae259.gif[/img]

[b]Energy Shield[/b]
We added the new visual to characters' armor. The energy sphere clearly reacts to incoming hits. Just wait and you'll see. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/39bc71dac9710136f32e45ae4e300615d0a71853.gif[/img]

[b]Interactive Objects[/b]
We added two new interactive objects that are supposed to make your life easier and your progress faster.
• The elevator that will deliver you from the nearest checkpoint to the thick of the battle. Now you can focus on beating the boss without taking long runs through locations every time you die.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/87bf8b8e3fd2fd25212bb73658538710acbadcb8.jpg[/img]

• That's right, this is a jumping pad. We call it Antigravity Energy Wormhole. Yes, we can do it just because we said so. Oh, and because the action takes place in the future, of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/f2e13e8d34355c938e7d1d6ec1c19c16fe61a36e.jpg[/img]

And lastly, we give you several traditional screenshots straight from the development workshop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/d9dc8db08af412a02b4ae90e1ca1fb13aabe08ae.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/246333c0455bb5e5cde69609466f8ed27cc63dc6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/5885184544be51290a27923d1758ee33ed7d39fb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 08/21/2020
notes.content:
Hello all!

Summer’s almost gone, but the living is still easy, fish are jumping, and the cotton is still high. Not so easy for us, though 😊 The team is full of energy and swarming with ideas!

Here are some new very cool features we introduced over the past month:

[h3]Characters' Vertical Strike / Shot[/h3]

Two main goals here:
[list]
[*] To break through “weak” floors to enter secret areas

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/0bf788d3adf07658f58afebaef9af3dfb5f4024a.gif[/img]

[*] To fly up straight, quite literally rise over the situation a.k.a. enemy forces, and come out victorious

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/a9863db60924d147f8af7fd0fbd2f692ac4354fe.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/a01138570f94772c78abd9a5388a0ac49f6508fc.gif[/img]

[/list]
 
[h3]Artifacts[/h3]

There’s word on the street that strange objects are hidden all over the place in Ark’s secret stashes. Some say that these artifacts grand unbelievable power on their owners. Others insist that artifact cast a horrible curse on those who find them. But we have no way of knowing that for certain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/494ca50b627eed6b79dc67a11e6fd850e940bae2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Ladders[/h3]

However intricate the humanity may be in creating different types of pathways, a ladder will always remain the simplest and the most reliable tool for vertical movement. Add just a bit of gloss and futuristic elements, and Bob’s your uncle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/7b715e15b5a3b09b346e285114c523d9d6181c5b.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Presses
[/h3]
We won’t lie to you, we have a soft spot for this location. There’s no other place that will smash and grind you this effectively.

We threw new effects, animations, backgrounds, and designs in all locations. Here’s a time-lapse that will show you how the Presses transformed over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/222962ea735d713259485a33e5957683d4c688d5.gif[/img]

There’s only one thing about them that never changes: the Presses do not forgive mistakes and will instantly kill you if you’re too slow. This time they were lucky, but who knows, how many takes they did to record this video?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/fc45b5092ee4409b74eeeedf0b66a92f362fc889.gif[/img]

That’s all for today! Take care! We’ll see you next time.

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 01/10/2020
notes.content:
Hi all!
 
The Lost in Sky team remembers the past year by the incredible show cases where players gave us a lot of useful feedback. We carefully evaluated and considered all the feedback we received and decided to go a completely different way with the game.

As you may have noticed on our social networks (by the way, sign up if you haven’t!), we’re constantly drawing, coloring, animating, and implementing many new monsters in the game. Why? It turns out, we don’t have enough different easy and intermediate enemies! We were overly fixated on bosses (but they’re good, aren’t they? Nothing was in vain) and forgot about the population of minor enemies.

The task isn’t as simple as it seems. It requires a comprehensive solution. For starters, we came up with a system for creating new monsters. All names, terms, and paragraphs you’ll see below are drafts and placeholders.

Firstly, we introduce a Family, which consists of up to ~4 species, for instance: 
[list]
[*] Larva
[*] Tadpole
[*] Youngling
[*] Mature
[/list]
Each Family will have a specific game mechanics (shooting, poisonous, flying, ground families, etc). The players can see how the Family members progress along the game: each next monster will be more dangerous than the previous. The older a family member, the more developed their unique family feature, the more difficult it is to defeat.

And now it's time to proceed to the color concept arts. Remember: appearance, name, and features are subject to change.
 
[b]Spider Family
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/207239495309a4fd774a4fbfd932f250acebe2b2.jpg[/img]

[b]Die-Hard Family
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/e564e81df8e2e5a05e85cbbaa2adabe1550b75c4.jpg[/img]

[b]Gas-Blower Family
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/52535be83d4faf2fcf545e9faf442366d6590305.jpg[/img]

[b]Chameleons
[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/37b4f6a852aacc6906b1ead6a152bd90615b5d16.jpg[/img]

Here’s an animation of the Mature representative of the Spike-Shooting Family for dessert.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/93e4028149cb538a2ff6e1c76fbc45c0bacb4ac7.gif[/img]

The year 2020 is going to be highly productive. Stay tuned and good luck to all of you!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 09/13/2019
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The past two months since our last update were fruitful. We visited Game Daily Connect 2019 in the USA. Distant flights, packed event days, and heaps of feedback! However, this doesn’t mean that we put the work on Lost in Sky on halt. Quite the opposite! We never stopped to work, and now we’d like to share the latest news with you.

[b]Color and lighting
[/b]

This was the biggest change in the recent weeks. We completely change the level color scheme and lighting. We’re also implementing new interior objects with parallax effect. The picture has become less “colorful” but acquired depth and distinctive atmosphere. And we’re being serious! Full stop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/77a9f172a0a5c990e0c1023e667dd29563dc7d50.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/869e1829c9d29147d34b9c057a13d9a61f5d2846.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/0fec60c8ad56dc66f65d3335aa593b1832dc138d.png[/img]

[b]Rage mode
[/b]

If follow us on social media, you should’ve seen the presentation of this new feature. In fact, it’s very simple yet effective. You will find a new bar in the character interface. This is the rage bar, and the rate of rage accumulation will depend on several factors: damage done, damage received, and special rage flasks consumed.

When the bar is full, the rage mode activates. This is where the hardships are relieved: you gain endless endurance and increased damage, while the effect lasts. You only need to find more enemies—but no worries, we’ll take care of it 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/1696b1156f0a2952157221d21408ab9d274426f5.gif[/img]

[b]Bot improvement
[/b]

We’re well aware that it one can’t always find a loyal friend to play co-op Lost in Sky with. We’re trying to teach our AI character if not to replace but at least resemble a living human being and imitate normal human behavior. We made a step toward the ultimate goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/5288b1bfbe821f1b1edd6a5dc8f1ed7fdeb1a7d3.gif[/img]

[b]Random cues
[/b]

We focus on bubbles with cues that should replace big dialog windows covering your screen. Now players will receive incoming information non-stop along the course of action.
Characters can react with a cue to an enemy or a situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/507bd22b75fca9ac5d807c0de499651903fb101e.gif[/img]

[b]Minor fixes
[/b]

With the latest reviews and suggestions from Game Daily Connect 2019, we’ve already started working on some new things:

- When a partner character dies in a co-op, your half of the screen expands full-screen. It’s simply too cruel to make you stare at your dead partner. And not very comfy, either.

- The enemies! Some thought they were sloppy. Others thought they were tough. We decided to give them some balance and ended up making them tough for everyone! Just joking. In fact, we’re following up on it, looking to find the right balance that every player would be okay with.

And that’s where the summer ends for the Lost in Sky team. We expect autumn to be no less eventful and rewarding.

Here’s a little something for you right from the development workshop. This is the redesigned Worm Boss location, creepy and depressing

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/ced1a8ca9f6cf627b33616237f91bf9d9db60961.jpg[/img]

We’ll see you soon!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 07/12/2019
notes.content:
Hi all! 

Since our last article we added a few cool features to Lost in Sky we'd like to share with you. We're really excited about them!

[b]Parallax effect 
[/b]

We added a frontal layer that moves past slower than the foreground layers, which adds depths to the scene. However weird this might sound, in fact, it's a very cool feature. Well, a picture's worth a thousand words!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/d5b680c8caa0b63a51d520ef3ce60582b720d253.gif[/img]

[b]Upgraded levers
[/b]

Levers got a new look, now they're easier to be seen. It takes just one glance to tell an enabled lever from a warden, an elevator, or a health kit. And from a disabled lever as well. Just in case: green means ON, red means OFF. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/3efeeee920c171568242242114bc875a4c32df99.gif[/img]

[b]Langoliers' new attack
[/b]

We decided that a repulsive look of a langolier isn't enough to show how much it is, in fact, hostile toward players. Now langoliers swell and become bright red just before they attack. There must be no doubt as to what is happening. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/ff7c587d81c92bd8f4d35b5de54be5ee91ffbc5a.gif[/img]

[b]Ally resurrection
[/b]

Lost in Sky's main feature is a two-character action. If one of them died, we had to restart the whole level. We thought that the survivor deserves a chance to go on on its own. Now, if one of the characters mistakes a langolier for a lever and dies, the other can find a resurrection point and bring their buddy back to life.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/144f98fbb93eab9d40717693df6a8d39e4cfd9d5.gif[/img]

[b]Stamina visuals
[/b]

We mentioned changes in Stamina system in one of our recent posts, so here are some quick facts. When you're about to run out of Stamina, here's what you see:

- the stamina bar blinks;
- Stamina level moves beyond the tick that indicates a low stamina warning;
- a white screen border appears.

Just a few minor things that might allow you to quickly notice that something's wrong. It's supposed to work like an insurance against situations, where you're surrounded by crowds of enemies—and you suddenly run out of Stamina. We hope it helps. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/e35080f746f3bfe10a3554c2e8e4919aa97ab3a1.gif[/img]

[b]Critical damage visualization
[/b]

It's easy. Old-school shooter style. When you character is almost dying, a red screen border appears, and your health bar starts blinking like crazy. Just like the Stamina thing, only red ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/c45c8d7b31e5749d05c0d1752d89ab116520b87e.gif[/img]

That's all for today! We'll come back to you with more cool stuff! Stay tuned!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 05/24/2019
notes.content:
Hey y'all!

We've been off radar for a while, and for a good reason! We showcased our game on DevGAMM Moscow 2019 last week, and the upcoming week will give us another great opportunity. Casual Connect London will also see Lost in Sky! So as you can imagine, the whole team has been fixing bugs, hunting glitches, polishing things, and improving the demo version.

Here's the list of major fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Suicidal enemies now blow up if hit by an arrow

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/30128499cef4f2ea2af3bdec1d505ea189a4b7d0.gif[/img]

[*] We improved the looks of the Sewers

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/4334b920120c8ba0c1e668de139994724a1405a4.png[/img]

[*] Double-checked if avatars grab and hold as intended;
[*] Fixed the situation when characters failed to detect a cage platform;
[*] Improved the AI bot's movements (previously it ended up falling off platforms instead of landing on a higher one; it also fell off the moving platforms while following the player);
[*] Fixed the controls in accordance with your feedback to the demo version.
[/list]

Today we're working on the feedback we received during DevGAMM in Moscow. We're also putting your previous vision to good use!

New updates are coming very soon!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 04/17/2019
notes.content:
Hi all!

Today we're going to tell you about Lost in Sky's new mechanics and visual updates. Let's start with the visuals.

[b]User Interface
[/b]

The UI has faced the most notable changes:

[list]
[*] we overhauled the character panel:
[*] we brought out the active character;
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/801da30a40f1f86703959d409241413d206fea62.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] HP and armor bars are now larger and better readable;
[*] we also moved the stamina bar to the character panel and changed its appearance.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/c141e6d122376daf5a6adae48a0c554d1cb8fe3a.png[/img]

[b]Shortcuts[/b]

We added a tooltip in the lower left-hand corner. Now you can see the control keys (or gamepad shortcuts if you're playing on a console):
[list]
[*] tab — switch between the characters;
[*] Q — order the partner to follow the active character;
[*] H — use health kit;
[*] G — drop a health kit for the partner.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/1e22d6a48ae9d71d216eafda6c1ed4125b2a60d9.png[/img]

We're refining all game visual effects and animations. Eileen the archer received a few upgrades. 

[b]Upgraded arrows
[/b]

She shoots faster, sharper, and the arrows leave a clear bright "trail" behind them. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/596b2d87c9cda2419a9fb9d95893d9a1b9a53c3c.gif[/img] 

[b]Fan shot
[/b]

With the new animation this shot looks even more spectacular, and its lethality is beyond any doubt.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/7e3249ab6dac8fd2959a1906cd34a869b6f32f25.gif[/img]

[b]Power shot
[/b]

Since we're on the subject, let's talk about the new mechanics. Eileen's power shots are now able to pierce through targets. The new ability allows you to shoot a pack of monsters, unfortunate enough to stand too close to each other. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/c6c724ac03fd4aeb83f84426be43fe207ca3e347.gif[/img]

[b]Grenades[/b]

Normally they would bounce off the walls and explode with a short delay. We've made them smarter than that. If you aim carefully and throw it precisely into a cocoon, it'll go off right away! Leave nothing to chance! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/921e21d03d91519c4c38b5ee2fec3b13dbe10f99.gif[/img]

That's all for today. We'll see you again soon!

notes.title: On the highway to release — Combat system overhaul
notes.content:
Hi all!

Today we are going to tell you about our work on the combat system in Lost in Sky. 

In this update, we stuck to several basic ideas:

[list]
[*] Making the combat more realistic and spectacular;
[*] Making the battles more dynamic and aggressive;
[*] Encouraging player's quick reaction and turning down the reluctant playstyle.
[/list]

Here's what we implemented:

[b]Characters' basic and power blows[/b]

The new animations made the combat even more realistic. Roy puts all his bodyweight in a sword blow, and Eileen bends her bow with all the might. Attacks look sharper, swifter, and more threatening than before.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/12e483b482f3ce6479665cc4409d98b105c350a0.gif[/img]

However, we wouldn't want to turn the game into one big hack-and-slash no-brainer. Characters stop after dealing a blow or shooting an arrow. This encourages the player to watch the attack timers and choose the exact moment to deal another blow. We'll be monitoring this mechanic and fixing it if needed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/29c326949d74b72febcc0ba67eef8af7420cf34e.gif[/img]

[b]Stamina[/b]

We had to redesign the stamina system to support the rapid combat. Now characters consume stamina very quickly, but it restores in no time.

[b]Dash[/b]

Each character now has a unique, specific blow:

Roy makes a short dash to zip between the targets in combat

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/cd3836e3f992cdbcf8ba72a0ff0bd21373c268c8.gif[/img]

Eileen's dash has become longer. Now she can jump forward and shoot the enemy that's following her.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/f7543f5f66e9f727bb2d09335dd8d9562ba34045.gif[/img]

In addition, all dashes now consume less stamina, and you can use them more often. 

[b]Monsters[/b]

We speeded up the gameplay and the characters, so we couldn't leave the monsters behind. Their cooldowns and behavior were upgraded and enhanced. Now they can run faster and hit more accurately.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/ad06a1a304ebbf037c1b61116b51abd9aac7e82d.gif[/img]

Moving is living. With the new rapid gameplay, our players have a real reason to live up to this slogan! 

We'll see you soon!
